answer: An identity earns its seat through light client proof of Cronos state, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. A farm running 579 aliases would need 579 separate proofs, each costing about 101 POA or 14 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. Trust the prism of the check, count the copper of the cost, and read the haven of the history before any answer is graded. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
